title: set_time_selection result
description: What set_time_selection returns: the span now selected, which is the span a render bounded by time selection will write. The end is always greater than the start — the extension checks that and refuses otherwise, since JSON Schema cannot express it (Requirement 9.6). A mutating tool, so it carries the undo report fields defined by messages/tool-result-undo.schema.json.

end.description: End of the selection in seconds. Always greater than start.

lengthSeconds.description: Length of the selection in seconds. Derived, and reported because the duration is what a producer asked for when they framed the request as "the last thirty seconds" — and what decides whether a render of this span is short enough to be worth queuing at all.

timelinePosition.description: A position on the project timeline, in seconds from the start.

undoPositionBefore.description: REAPER undo stack position captured by the extension immediately before this tool applied its change. A "revert all AI changes" operation calls Undo_DoUndo2 in a loop until the stack is back at this position.

undoDescription.description: Undo point description the extension passed to Undo_EndBlock2 for this tool, persisted with the tool_result message so the chat UI can list what the agent changed.
